scope: Node tests with storage/file-handle doubles; native directory permissions and browser persistence are not exercised

tests.name: Later local edits take precedence over embedded portable seed
A newer exported seed beats an older stored copy
Corrupt saved copy falls back to validated portable seed
Non-numeric revision is rejected before import
Whole-folder read imports independently edited JSON, not stale backup
One malformed file aborts folder import without partial publication
Missing file is not silently replaced by a default
Queued writes preserve latest revision under overlapping saves
